query:
CREATE TABLE `banks` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`bank_number` int NOT NULL,
	`is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
	`is_occupied` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	`current_queue_entry_id` int,
	`total_served` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `banks_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `queue_entries` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`ticket_number` int NOT NULL,
	`bank_id` int,
	`status` enum('waiting','called','serving','completed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting',
	`called_at` timestamp,
	`served_at` timestamp,
	`completed_at` timestamp,
	`waiting_time_ms` bigint,
	`service_time_ms` bigint,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `queue_entries_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `queue_entries_ticket_number_unique` UNIQUE(`ticket_number`)
);

CREATE TABLE `system_config` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`total_banks` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
	`is_system_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
	`current_queue_number` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `system_config_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `system_logs` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`event_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
	`bank_id` int,
	`queue_entry_id` int,
	`details` text,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `system_logs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
